ev.en: The Riemann Hypothesis: every nontrivial zero of ζ(s) has real part 1/2.
ev.zh: 黎曼猜想：ζ(s) 的非平凡零点，实部全都等于 1/2。

ev.en: Eighteen fifty-nine.
A man writes one quiet line:
ev.zh: 一个人轻轻写下一句话：

ev.en: Very probably.
ev.zh: “很可能如此。”

ev.en: ζ ties all the positive integers to all the primes.
ev.zh: ζ 函数一头连着全体正整数，一头连着全体素数。

ev.en: Where the zeros sit decides how well we can count the primes.
ev.zh: 零点在哪里，决定了素数分布的误差有多小。

ev.en: Riemann drew a line across the dark
ev.zh: 黎曼在黑暗里画下一条线

ev.en: Every zero falling on one-half
ev.zh: 每一个零点，都落在实部 1/2 上

ev.en: A hundred sixty years of chalk and ash
ev.zh: 一百六十年，粉笔与灰烬

ev.en: Everyone could see it, no one made it last
ev.zh: 人人都看得见，却没人能把它钉牢

ev.en: Out in finite fields the story's told
ev.zh: 在有限域里，故事早已讲完

ev.en: Weil found the answer, Stepanov the road
ev.zh: 韦伊找到了答案，斯捷潘诺夫找到了路

ev.en: Build a function, make it vanish at each point
ev.zh: 造一个函数，让它在每个点上都为零

ev.en: Stack the multiplicity till the zeros have nowhere to go
ev.zh: 把重数一层层叠高，零点便无处可逃

ev.en: But the integers won't give you that
ev.zh: 可整数不给你这个

ev.en: No Frobenius, no way back
ev.zh: 没有弗罗贝尼乌斯，也没有退路

ev.en: If the world won't hand you multiplicity
ev.zh: 既然世界不肯递给你重数

ev.en: Build it
ev.zh: 那就自己造

ev.en: Lift it, lift it, theta after theta
ev.zh: 提升，再提升，一个 θ 接一个 θ

ev.en: Square root of X in a chain of light
ev.zh: √X 次提升，连成一条光链

ev.en: Unitary to unitary, higher and higher
ev.zh: 从酉群到酉群，越升越高

ev.en: Every zero coming home tonight
ev.zh: 今夜，每个零点都要回家

ev.en: To the line, to the line, to the line at one-half
ev.zh: 回到那条线，回到那条线，回到实部 1/2 的那条线

ev.en: Each θ-lift wins one more layer of multiplicity; √X lifts copy the finite-field trick.
ev.zh: 每做一次 θ 提升，多赢一层重数；连提 √X 次，模仿有限域里的高重数。

ev.en: Rallis on a seesaw, both sides balance even
ev.zh: Rallis 的跷跷板，两边恰好相等

ev.en: The period turns Bessel, the characters fall away
ev.zh: 周期化成 Bessel 周期，特征标纷纷退场

ev.en: Iwasawa towers climbing floor by floor
ev.zh: 岩泽塔，一层一层往上盖

ev.en: Like a finite field that keeps on opening doors
ev.zh: 像有限域那样，一扇门接一扇门地打开

ev.en: Primes and zeros settle up in the explicit formula
ev.zh: 素数和零点，在显式公式里两清

ev.en: A positive sign where the variance falls
ev.zh: 方差落下的地方，是一个正号

ev.en: No more Gauss sums, just Parseval k times
ev.zh: 不再用高斯和，只做 k 次 Parseval

ev.en: Square-root cancellation, honest as it climbs
ev.zh: 平方根级的抵消，一步一步，老老实实

ev.en: Every lift has a price to pay
ev.zh: 每一次提升都有代价

ev.en: Two-thirds of the way, it wants to stay
ev.zh: 走到三分之二，它就想停下

ev.en: Twist away the last stubborn ghost
ev.zh: 用扭曲赶走最后一个顽固的幽灵

ev.en: Vandiver's shadow, where the K-groups hold
ev.zh: 在 Vandiver 猜想的影子里，K 群撑住了

ev.en: Lift it, lift it, theta after theta
ev.zh: 提升，再提升，一个 θ 接一个 θ

ev.en: Square root of X in a chain of light
ev.zh: √X 次提升，连成一条光链

ev.en: Unitary to unitary, higher and higher
ev.zh: 从酉群到酉群，越升越高

ev.en: Every zero coming home tonight
ev.zh: 今夜，每个零点都要回家

ev.en: To the line, to the line, to the line at one-half
ev.zh: 回到那条线，回到那条线，回到实部 1/2 的那条线

ev.en: Seventeen million lines of Lean
ev.zh: 一千七百万行 Lean 代码

ev.en: Scanned for sorry, and found none
ev.zh: 搜遍 sorry，一个也没有

ev.en: No new axioms, but the build's not done
ev.zh: 没有新公理，但独立编译还没跑完

ev.en: Levent and Claude hand it to the kernel
ev.zh: Levent 和 Claude 把它交给内核

ev.en: When the build is done and the axioms are read
ev.zh: 等编译跑完，公理清单读出来

ev.en: Only three names left, nothing else instead
ev.zh: 只剩三个名字，别无其他

ev.en: Then the line is drawn
ev.zh: 那条线，才算真正画下

ev.en: The line at one-half
ev.zh: 实部 1/2 的那条线

ev.en: The line at one-half
ev.zh: 实部 1/2 的那条线

ev.en: Note: as of 2026-11-20 there is no public independent build or peer review of this proof.
ev.zh: 注：截至 2026-11-20，这份证明尚无公开的独立编译与同行审查。
